exposure: Healthy Life Trajectories Initiative (HeLTI) South Africa intervention (a preconception life-course intervention)
cohort: Young women in urban Soweto, participating in a preconception to early childhood life-course intervention.
finding: This protocol paper describes a framework for monitoring fidelity in a complex preconception life-course intervention in a low- and middle-income setting, identifying context-specific challenges and proposing solutions to improve adherence, reporting, and monitoring of intervention fidelity.
followup_time: Through pregnancy, infancy, and early childhood
